verdict.rationale: Firecrawl returns scraped content in standard, portable formats such as markdown, HTML and structured JSON. It is also AGPL-3.0 open source and self-hostable, which reduces provider lock-in. Nothing in the evidence documents exporting job or crawl configurations, or a dedicated bulk data-export or migration feature. missing for 10: export of job/crawl configurations, a dedicated bulk export or migration tooling for previously scraped data, documented portability guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export my scraped data and job configurations in a portable format to migrate to another provider without lock-in

citations.quote: Extract content from any URL as markdown, HTML, or structured JSON
LLM-ready output: Clean markdown, structured JSON, screenshots, and more
Firecrawl is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license.
Open source and available as a hosted service
